literal: Unlearned man's getting angry small matter always him who cannot achieve will not reach glory.
translation: Glory will never reach the man who cannot accomplish the small task of overcoming an ignorant man's anger.
modern: அறிவில்லாதவன் கொள்ளும் சினம் என்னும் சிறிய செயலைக்கூடச் செய்து முடிக்க இயலாதவனை, புகழ் எக்காலத்திலும் சென்றடையாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights how easy it is to defeat an ignorant enemy. The anger of an unlearned man is called a 'small matter' (சிறுபொருள்) because overcoming it requires very little effort and yields an easy advantage. If a leader is unable to accomplish even this simple task, true glory will never reach them. The word 'ஒளி' literally means light, here symbolizing the radiant fame that eludes the incapable.
